name: Divine Light
body:
School evocation; Level adept 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1, white necromancer 1

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like the lesser divine light spell except the damage dealt is 1d4/level (maximum 5d4) to living creatures, or 1d6/level (maximum 5d6) to undead creatures.
